name: Shanghai Hanbell Precise Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Hanbell Precise Machinery Co., Ltd. engages in the production, sale, and after-sales service of compressors in China. The company offers air end, refrigerant, scroll, and air compressors, as well as vacuum pumps. It also provides service network and IoT cloud platform. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Hanbell Machinery Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shanghai Hanbell Precise Machinery Co., Ltd. in December 2005. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Shanghai, China.
